title: ShatterRip instance
description: Per-template schema for shatter. Core TemplateConfig fields (theme/global) are $ref-d from the global animations.schema.json. This template does NOT own content — it shatters arbitrary `children` passed by the caller, so `elements[]` is unconstrained (any id) and typically empty. extras.* are extended here.

elements.description: Currently unused by shatter itself — content is passed as `children` to <ShatterRip>. Kept in the schema for DeepConfig pipeline compatibility.

radius.description: Radius of the shatter lens, relative to the screen height. The lens sweeps horizontally across the frame during the composition

softness.description: Edge feather of the lens as a fraction of the radius (0 to 1)

shards.description: Shape irregularity. 0 keeps a perfect square grid, 1 breaks the page into uneven glass shards

corner.description: Corner rounding of fully lifted tiles in CSS pixels

lift.description: How high tiles lift off the page in CSS pixels

tilt.description: How steeply tiles tip out of the page plane (0 to 3)

scatter.description: How far tiles slide sideways while lifted, in CSS pixels

perspective.description: Perspective distance in CSS pixels. Lower is more dramatic

gapColor.description: Color of the void behind lifted tiles as [r, g, b] in 0-1 range

shadow.description: Opacity of the drop shadows under lifted tiles (0 to 2)

shading.description: Strength of the per-tile lighting (0 to 2)

refraction.description: How strongly lifted shards refract the content beneath them, like glass (0 to 2)

dispersion.description: Chromatic fringing of the refraction (0 to 1). 0 keeps it color-true

floatSpeed.description: Speed of the floating tile motion. 0 freezes the tiles

strength.description: How fully tiles lift inside the lens (0 to 1)

baseStrength.description: Lift amount across the whole screen, outside the lens (0 to 1)

lensPath.description: Lens path: waypoints {x, y, at} the lens follows over the composition. x/y are normalized screen positions (y is CSS-style: 0 = top, 1 = bottom; x outside 0-1 moves the lens off-frame for enter/exit). at is composition progress (0-1). The lens moves between waypoints with smoothstep timing. Default: a left-to-right sweep across the composition. A static lens = two identical waypoints. Empty/missing falls back to the default sweep

x.description: Normalized horizontal lens center (0-1 across the frame; outside the frame for enter/exit)

y.description: Normalized vertical lens center, CSS y-down (0 = top, 1 = bottom)

at.description: Composition progress (0-1) at which the lens reaches this waypoint

activePath.description: Activation envelope: waypoints {at, v} of the lens's uActive over the composition. v = 0 lens off, 1 fully on; at is composition progress (0-1). Smoothstepped between waypoints. Default: on for the whole composition. 'Shatter at 60% and hold' = [{at: 0, v: 0}, {at: 0.6, v: 1}]; 'then reform at 80%' adds {at: 0.8, v: 0}

at.description: Composition progress (0-1) at which the envelope reaches this value

v.description: uActive value at this waypoint (0 = lens off, 1 = fully on)

scrollTo.description: How much of the page's scroll distance the composition covers: 1 scrolls top to bottom, -1 bottom to top, |v| < 1 covers a fraction, 0 pins the page still (the lens still works over a static page)
